decisions.reason: The accepted tip presets and custom-tip option do not change the Transak provider, fiat methods, conversion asset, or buyer-access requirements.
The gratuity is optional and separate from the fixed mint price and revenue allocation, so those values remain unchanged.
Adding preset and custom optional tip amounts does not affect the NFT ebook format or unlimited edition supply.
The tip design does not alter the no-referral commission amount, trigger, or recipient-selection rule.
The accepted gratuity options do not change the referral-code source, persistence, or display locations.
Optional tip amounts are independent of the coded-referral commission amount, trigger, recipient, and payout behavior.
The source accepts the mint-page tipping controls but does not request or necessarily entail a corresponding change to the approved FAQ content.
The optional gratuity design does not modify Small Block winners, prize amounts, eligibility, draw triggers, or pool funding.
Mint-page tipping does not change the flat secondary-sale royalty or its disclosure.
The tip amount controls do not alter SIWE authentication, supported user paths, or protected wallet flows.
The source approves tipping controls on the minting page but does not require any change to the About-page copy or topics.
The optional gratuity design does not alter the Big Block winner count, prize amount, or draw condition.
